title: Complete domain migration of solar, radiation, clock-time and seasonal ecological research from ODSP to RSDS
scope: All identified ecological positive/null/negative result documents, scripts, tests, original public source-derived data, Movebank catalogues and historical workflow files; not unrelated ODSP generic prediction engine
nontransferred_binary: research/seasonal_database_catalog/2026-10-19/movebank/raw_pages.tar.gz (raw retrieved catalogue pages; materialized semantic catalogue csv/json and provider manifest are transferred)
data_policy: Original tagged animal raw GPS is not transferred or republished; retained source-derived summaries and provider source manifests only
identity_check: Each transferred target Git blob must equal the source blob SHA listed here; if any mismatch or missing file, migration is not complete
historical_workflows: Original ODSP GitHub Actions workflows moved under archive/odsp_workflows, not active RSDS workflows
